newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EXTERNAL DEBT $1.2 BILLION AT THE END OF MAY.
newsitem.headline: EXTERNAL DEBT $1.2 BILLION AT THE END OF MAY.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Wednesday that the country's external debt in hard currency stood at $1.2 billion at the end of May, a $23 million increase from the beginning of the year.
The ministry also said in a statement that as of May 31, $875 million of it was taken in the name of state, a $10.4 million decrease compared to the beginning of the year.
The debt from government guarantees rose by $33.4 million and stood at $325 million at the end of May, the ministry said.
It added that the total external debt accounted for 12.7 percent of the country's gross domestic product (GDP).
The ministry added that the calculations were carried out according to the official exchange rate of the Bank of Lithuania as of May 31.
